name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Transparent And Mirror Acrylic Ornament
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted with a 2-layer construction combining clear acrylic and mirror acrylic for a refined, dimensional look.
    - Layer 1: Durable 3 mm transparent acrylic with a smooth, glossy finish.
    - Layer 2: Premium 3 mm mirror acrylic for a bright reflective accent.
    - Mirror acrylic options include Gold Mirror Acrylic and Silver Mirror Acrylic.
    - Comes with included hanging accessories for easy display.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in sizes:
                +) 3.54 × 3.54 in ~ 9 × 9 cm
                +) 4 × 4 in ~ 10.16 × 10.16 cm
                +) 5 × 5 in ~ 12.7 × 12.7 cm
                +) 6 × 6 in ~ 15.24 × 15.24 cm
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Engraving & Printing Technology:
    - Produced using precision laser cutting for clean, sharp custom silhouette shapes.
    - Acrylic layer features high-quality UV printing for vibrant, detailed artwork.
    - Mirror acrylic layer uses laser engraving to display personalized names and text.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a personalized hanging ornament for decorative display.
    - Lightweight yet durable for long-term use.
    - Two-layer construction creates a modern dimensional appearance.
    - Ideal for hanging on Christmas trees, walls, doors, windows, hooks, or display stands.
    - Included hanging accessories make it easy to use right away.
    - Great for showcasing custom names, event details, or meaningful personal messages.
    - Reusable as a keepsake decoration for holidays and special occasions.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for Christmas, birthdays, anniversaries, and housewarmings.
    - Great for long-distance friendships, couples, families, and loved ones living apart.
    - Ideal for weddings, engagements, graduations, moving-away gifts, and reunions.
    - A meaningful keepsake for celebrating hometowns, travel memories, special places, and personal connections.

  • Processing Time: 1-3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6-9 working days average (US)
  • Packaging:1 xCustom Shape 2-Layer Transparent And Mirror Acrylic Ornament

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
